# Codex relay capture

Terminal regions captured through `herdr agent read --source recent-unwrapped`
in round 40 while dana was working on #2177. Codex was 0.164.0.

- `absent.txt`: the pane before the relay was sent, with no delivery evidence.
- `delivered.txt`: the pane after the signed relay arrived. The installed dispatch
  still exited 6 with “never picked up the brief”.
- `delivered-tag.txt`: `delivered.txt` rewritten by hand into the format #2658
  introduced: the relay's opening tag carries the sequence and a closing tag
  precedes the signature. Everything else is the capture. `delivered.txt` stays
  as a pane captured before the change.

Unrelated scrollback was removed. The test adjusts the relay sequence to the
sequence generated by its fixture; the captured wrapping and prompt markers stay.
The prompt-stalled RPC response is simulated; the capture contains dispatch's
failure output, not the underlying herdr RPC response.
